newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: International Exchange Bank to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: International Exchange Bank to raise capital.

text.p: International Exchange Bank of the Philippines said on Monday its stockholders had agreed to infuse an additional one billion pesos in capital in order to make the bank a major player in the financial markets.

The additional capital will raise the bank's paid-up capital to 2.5 billion pesos by the end of next year, it said in a statement. The new capital will be in five quarterly tranches of 200 million pesos starting from December.
Among the bank's major shareholders are Philippine Realty and Holdings Corp, and Palawan Oil & Gas Exploration Inc, which is being renamed Genesis Financial Equities Inc.

The bank said it will mark its first year of operations on September 25 with estimated profits of 120 million pesos. The bank now has assets of over 12 billion pesos against a target of 6.0 to 7.0 billion pesos, it said.
